title: Account-deletion file cleanup through ASGI restart
classification: A committed failed file-cleanup job is retried and completed by the actual ASGI lifespan startup worker in a fresh child process.

verification.result: passed: 1 test on Python 3.14.10 and PostgreSQL 17.6
verification.database: Fresh oneirodexr1978test database upgraded from the Alembic baseline through head with scripts/upgrade_test_schema.py; dropped after the test. TEST_DATABASE_URL and DATABASE_URL were process-scoped overrides; the root .env was not changed.

method.restart_boundary: The test commits a failed cleanup job in the parent process, then starts a new child process and drives the production LazyASGIApp through Uvicorn LifespanOn startup and shutdown.
assertions: the child application selects the validated loopback test database
ASGI startup starts the real post-commit file-cleanup worker
the worker removes the managed file and its completed retry row
method.side_effect_limits: Unrelated scan, polling, anti-cheat and save-location schedulers are stubbed in the child process; no provider requests or library scans run.

limits: This uses the current Alembic schema, not a deployed operator schema.
It does not qualify production redeployment, restore/reapplication, or other background scheduler behavior.
